inlines.v: INCRED'IBLE, adjective [Latin incredibilis; in and credibilis, credible.] That cannot be believed; not to be credited; too extraordinary and improbable to admit of belief. Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead? Acts 26:8.
